Name: Shapefile DES
Description: This DES defines the three files (e.g. SHP, SHX, and DBF) which together comprise the description of an Esri Shapefile.

SHAPE_USE.Name: Shapefile Use
SHAPE_USE.Description: This field indicates what the Shapefile data represents.

SHAPE_CLASS.Name: Shape Type
SHAPE_CLASS.Description: This field represents the type of shapes contained with this Shapefile.

CC_SOURCE.Name: Cloud Cover Source Sensor
CC_SOURCE.Description: This field indicates the source sensor(s) for determining cloud cover (appears only if SHAPE_USE is CLOUD_SHAPES).

SHAPE1_NAME.Name: File Type for First File in the Shapefile
SHAPE1_NAME.Description: This is the name/type (i.e. SHP, SHX, DBF) of the first file in the Shapefile.

SHAPE1_START.Name: Start Location of First File in the Shapefile
SHAPE1_START.Description: This is the start location in bytes of the first file, expressed as an offset in the DES User-Defined Data.

SHAPE2_NAME.Name: File Type for Second File in the Shapefile
SHAPE2_NAME.Description: This is the name/type (i.e. SHP, SHX, DBF) of the second file in the Shapefile.

SHAPE2_START.Name: Start Location of Second File in the Shapefile
SHAPE2_START.Description: This is the start location in bytes of the second file, expressed as an offset in the DES User-Defined Data.

SHAPE3_NAME.Name: File Type for Third File in Shapefile
SHAPE3_NAME.Description: This is the name/type (i.e. SHP, SHX, DBF) of the third file in the Shapefile.

SHAPE3_START.Name: Start Location of Third File in the Shapefile
SHAPE3_START.Description: This is the start location in bytes of the third file, expressed as an offset in the DES User-Defined Data.
